bullet_points: The news highlights the trending status of the Meta-Llama-3-8B model on Hugging Face.
It is categorized under key AI/ML domains including transformers, llama, and text-generation.
This indicates ongoing community interest and benchmarking activity around Meta's latest open-weight models.

stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights the trending status of the Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct model on Hugging Face.
It is categorized under key NLP/ML tags including 'transformers' and 'text-generation'.
The mention of Meta's Llama series indicates continued focus on leading open-source LLMs.

stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights the trending status of the 'deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1' model on Hugging Face Benchmarks.
The model is categorized under text-generation and conversational AI pipelines.
It utilizes standard ML frameworks indicated by tags like transformers and safetensors.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Pro
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Highlights the trending status of the DeepSeek-V4-Pro model on Hugging Face.
The model is categorized for text generation and conversational AI tasks.
It utilizes standard ML components like transformers and safetensors.

stories.title: Ollama: all aboard open models
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama, a platform for running open models, has secured significant funding.
The company raised $88 million from prominent investors including Y Combinator and Benchmark.
Ollama currently serves a substantial community of 8.9 million developers.

stories.title: Faster Gemma 4 on MLX with multi-token prediction
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Gemma 4 performance is significantly boosted on Apple Silicon through Ollama 0.31.
The speed improvement is attributed to the implementation of Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) powered by MLX.
Coding agent tasks show up to 90% faster performance according to the Aider polyglot benchmark.

stories.title: Ollama's highest performance on Apple Silicon yet with MLX
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama has achieved its peak performance on Apple Silicon using the MLX engine.
The performance improvements result in higher quality model outputs.
The updated engine also delivers faster response times and reduced memory usage.

stories.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Introduction of NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra, a new AI model.
The model is specifically engineered for high-throughput reasoning tasks.
It is designed to support complex, long-running agent workflows.

stories.title: OpenJarvis: a local-first personal AI is now available to run with Ollama
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: OpenJarvis v1.0 is released, offering an open-source framework for personal AI agents.
The key feature is that these agents can run entirely on the user's local hardware.
It features built-in support for Ollama, leveraging local LLM execution.

stories.title: Ollama is now powered by MLX on Apple Silicon in preview
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama, a popular local LLM runner, is integrating MLX for performance optimization.
This integration specifically targets Apple Silicon hardware, offering significant speed improvements.
The feature is currently available in a preview state, indicating ongoing development.

stories.title: Quantum error correction can constantly recalibrate a processor
stories.author: John Timmer
bullet_points: Quantum error correction is being advanced by using continuous recalibration methods.
Reinforcement learning is employed to leverage error information for dynamic algorithm adjustments.
This represents a significant step toward building stable and functional quantum processors.

stories.title: Ransomware negotiator hired to represent victims was working for the attackers
stories.author: Jon Brodkin
bullet_points: A ransomware negotiator was arrested for betraying his clients.
The individual was found to be working on behalf of the ransomware attackers.
The case resulted in a six-year prison sentence for the negotiator.

stories.title: Scalable Visual Pretraining for Language Intelligence
stories.author: Kai Chen
bullet_points: Current large foundation models heavily rely on text-based pretraining, overlooking crucial visual information.
The paper addresses the limitation of text-only models by proposing scalable visual pretraining methods.
This approach aims to capture rich knowledge embedded in visual cues like figures, equations, and document layouts.

stories.title: Evolution of Accuracy and Visual-Cognitive Errors in a Decade of Vision-Language AI Models
stories.author: Miguel P. Eckstein
bullet_points: The research addresses a limitation in current VLM evaluations, which often use simple scenes (like MS-COCO) and lack complexity.
A new benchmark, the Complex Social Behavior (CSB) dataset, is introduced to test VLMs on 100 images depicting complex human interactions.
The study focuses on analyzing the evolution of accuracy and specifically identifying the types of visual-cognitive errors made by these models.

stories.title: VEXAIoT: Autonomous IoT Vulnerability EXploitation using AI Agents
stories.author: Maanak Gupta
bullet_points: Introduces VEXAIoT, an autonomous multi-agent framework designed for IoT vulnerability exploitation.
Addresses the critical security gap in IoT systems caused by hardware constraints and insecure configurations.
Applies advanced AI agents (LLM-based) to a previously unexplored domain: IoT-specific penetration testing.

stories.title: A Sovereign, Open-Source Foundation Model for German and English
stories.author: Max Lübbering
bullet_points: Introduction of Soofi S 30B-A3B, a sovereign, open-source MoE hybrid Mamba Transformer foundation model.
Features a significant throughput advantage for long-context deployment by activating only 3B of 30B parameters per token.
Specifically designed for German and English, pretrained on 27 trillion tokens with German language emphasis.

stories.title: Improved performance and model support with GGUF
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama 0.30 release introduces significant performance improvements.
Enhanced GGUF model compatibility is now available via llama.cpp integration.
The update expands model support across various hardware, augmenting the MLX engine on Apple silicon.

stories.title: Subagents and web search in Claude Code
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama has integrated support for advanced AI features within Claude Code.
The new capabilities include the implementation of subagents for complex task decomposition.
Web search functionality has been added, enhancing the model's ability to access real-time information.

stories.title: OpenClaw
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: OpenClaw is a personal AI assistant designed to integrate with messaging applications.
It utilizes local AI coding agents, ensuring data processing occurs entirely on the user's device.
The core value proposition is providing private, on-device AI assistance for coding tasks.

stories.title: Apple’s failed self-driving car program left a legacy of powerful AI chips
stories.author: Terrence O’Brien
bullet_points: Apple's abandoned self-driving car project is theorized to be a catalyst for its current powerful on-device AI chip capabilities.
The program highlighted an early and critical need for high-performance, localized AI processing within automotive systems.
The article suggests that the R&D efforts, even without a finished car processor, significantly advanced Apple's AI hardware expertise.

stories.title: China recovered its first reusable rocket and showed a new way to do it
stories.author: Stephen Clark
bullet_points: China has successfully recovered its first reusable rocket.
The recovery demonstrated a new methodology for achieving reusability.
The effort is noted as an attempt to replicate successful technologies pioneered by SpaceX.

stories.title: PHINN-EEG: Topological Time-Series Analysis of Dream-State EEG -- Dynamic Betti Curves for Dream Content Classification and Topology-Conditioned Neural Signal Synthesis
stories.author: Jayabrata Bhaduri
bullet_points: Introduces PHINN-EEG, a novel topological time-series framework for analyzing EEG data during dream states.
Moves beyond traditional PSD and statistical features used in current dream detection methods.
Employs Persistent Homology concepts to classify dream content and condition neural signal synthesis.

stories.title: ConceptSMILE: Auditing the Trustworthiness of Concept-Based Explainable AI
stories.author: Zhibao Mian
bullet_points: Introduces ConceptSMILE, a new model-agnostic framework for auditing the trustworthiness of concept-based Explainable AI (XAI).
Addresses the limitation that concept-level explanations, while human-understandable, are not inherently reliable.
Extends perturbation-based auditing logic (similar to SMILE) from feature/region attribution to concept explanations.

stories.title: Semantic Pareto-DQN: A Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning Framework for Financial Anomaly Detection
stories.author: Lucca Machado da Silva
bullet_points: Addresses the 'fraud collapse' problem in financial anomaly detection caused by extreme class imbalance.
Introduces Semantic Pareto-DQN, a multi-objective reinforcement learning framework to balance detection and customer friction.
Novelty lies in synthesizing heterogeneous transaction features into natural-language narratives for better encoding.

stories.title: 4DR360: State Reasoning for Joint 3D Detection and Occupancy Prediction in 4D Radar-Camera Full-Scene Perception
stories.author: Hui-liang Shen
bullet_points: Introduces 4DR360, a new method for joint 3D object detection and occupancy prediction using radar-camera fusion.
Addresses the limitation of sparse radar returns by integrating radar data with camera information for full-scene perception.
Improves upon existing methods by enabling deeper interaction between detection and occupancy tasks, moving beyond simple dual-task systems.

stories.title: Agora: Enhancing LLM Agent Reasoning Via Auction-Based Task Allocation
stories.author: Yue Feng
bullet_points: Proposes 'Agora,' a new framework to enhance LLM agent reasoning.
Addresses limitations in current LLM orchestration by moving beyond coarse-grained task matching.
Introduces an auction-based mechanism to optimize task allocation based on performance variability and cost efficiency among expert models.

stories.title: PHINN-EEG: Topological Time-Series Analysis of Dream-State EEG -- Dynamic Betti Curves for Dream Content Classification and Topology-Conditioned Neural Signal Synthesis
stories.author: Jayabrata Bhaduri
bullet_points: Introduces PHINN-EEG, a novel topological time-series framework for analyzing EEG signals during dream states.
Moves beyond traditional PSD and statistical features used in current dream detection methods.
Utilizes Persistent Homology concepts to classify dream content and condition neural signal synthesis.

stories.title: Semantic Pareto-DQN: A Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning Framework for Financial Anomaly Detection
stories.author: Lucca Machado da Silva
bullet_points: Proposes Semantic Pareto-DQN, a multi-objective RL framework for financial anomaly detection.
Addresses the 'fraud collapse' issue caused by extreme class imbalance in financial data.
Innovatively synthesizes heterogeneous transaction features into natural-language narratives for encoding.

stories.title: LLM for EDA in Front-End Design: Challenges and Opportunities
stories.author: Ulf Schlichtmann
bullet_points: LLMs are being explored as a potential solution to bottlenecks in front-end chip design.
The technology aims to move beyond simple specification understanding to assist with HDL generation and testbench construction.
The integration of agentic AI is highlighted as a key area for realizing LLM's potential in Electronic Design Automation (EDA).

stories.title: Entropy-Constrained Machine Learning with Residual Data Augmentation for Modeling Chemical Kinetics
stories.author: Opeoluwa Owoyele
bullet_points: Introduces a physics-constrained ML framework to accelerate Direct Numerical Simulation (DNS) of turbulent reacting flows.
Uses a surrogate model to predict chemical reaction rates from reduced thermochemical states, bypassing detailed source term evaluation.
Incorporates the second law of thermodynamics as a training constraint (non-negative entropy generation) to ensure physical consistency.

stories.title: Beyond Fixed Representations: The Vocabulary and Verifier Gaps in Open-Ended AI
stories.author: Haiqian Yang
bullet_points: Current advanced AI systems (reasoning, coding, etc.) suffer from a fundamental limitation: their operational framework is fixed.
This fixed framework includes the model's conceptual vocabulary, the search space for solutions, and predefined success criteria.
The paper proposes addressing these 'Vocabulary and Verifier Gaps' to enable stronger, more flexible AI capabilities.

stories.title: The Count Is There, but Misaligned: Understanding and Correcting Counting Failures in VLMs
stories.author: Kentaro Inui
bullet_points: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) exhibit failures in basic object counting despite strong overall multimodal performance.
Research suggests VLMs may encode the correct count internally, even when their verbalized output is incorrect.
Nonlinear probes applied to VLM activations can reliably detect these counting errors, pointing to a gap between internal representation and output.

stories.title: CoCoT-EEG: Contrastive-Pretrained Multiscale Convolutional Transformer for EEG Decoding
stories.author: Richard Gao
bullet_points: Introduces CoCoT-EEG, a new model combining Contrastive Pretraining and Multiscale Convolutional Transformers for EEG decoding.
Addresses limitations of existing EEG decoding methods that rely on raw EEG tokenization and masked reconstruction pretraining.
Proposes a novel approach tailored for noisy EEG data where critical information is often confined to narrow frequency bands.

stories.title: Agora: Enhancing LLM Agent Reasoning Via Auction-Based Task Allocation
stories.author: Yue Feng
bullet_points: Proposes 'Agora,' a new framework to improve LLM agent reasoning.
Addresses limitations in current LLM orchestration by moving beyond coarse-grained task matching.
Introduces an auction-based mechanism to allocate tasks, considering performance variability and cost efficiency among expert models.

stories.title: Tokenizer Transplantation: Mitigating Autoregressive Collapse in Edge-Efficient Bengali ASR
stories.author: Md. Abdur Rahman
bullet_points: The research addresses a critical limitation in deploying lightweight ASR models on edge devices for morphologically rich languages like Bengali.
The core problem identified is that English-centric byte-level tokenizers cause 'autoregressive collapse' when processing Bengali words.
A novel 'vocabulary transplantation pipeline' is proposed as the solution to improve model performance on non-Latin languages.

stories.title: FreyaTTS Technical Report
stories.author: Mustafa Yavuz
bullet_points: Introduction of Freya-TTS, a compact, tokenizer-free Text-to-Speech model specifically designed for Turkish.
The model utilizes a 183.2M-parameter non-autoregressive Conditional Flow-Matching Diffusion Transformer (DiT).
It operates efficiently by mapping text to a latent space derived from AudioVAE2, ensuring high-quality 48 kHz audio reconstruction.

stories.title: Test-Time Scaling for Small VLMs on Multilingual Visual MCQ
stories.author: Peng-Jian Yang
bullet_points: Investigates the applicability of Test-Time Scaling (TTS) techniques to small, open Vision-Language Models (VLMs).
Evaluates TTS effectiveness on EXAMS-V, a multilingual visual multiple-choice benchmark, using models like Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct.
Highlights that the operational conditions of TTS are more critical than the specific search or verification mechanisms used.

stories.title: GhostLock, a stack-UAF that has existed in all Linux distributions for 15 years
stories.author: ranger_danger
bullet_points: A vulnerability named 'GhostLock' has been discovered.
This vulnerability is a Use-After-Free (UAF) type of flaw.
The flaw reportedly exists across all Linux distributions and has been present for 15 years.
